name: the Simurgh
terms: answers whoever holds the feather, and answers anyone who holds it
defection_trigger: the feather changes hands; she arrives green and stops being green
signature_mechanic: 5 HP/turn to rider and adjacent allies (flat, not percentage)
notes: cleanses corruption; the only thing that can strip a pact without a Pardoner, and will not do it on request

name: the Huma
pact_object: no seal; it cannot be owned
terms: cannot be owned, only flown under; its shadow legitimizes whoever it falls on
defection_trigger: never defects because it was never yours
signature_mechanic: MAP HAZARD, NOT A MOUNT: drifts overhead; marked units gain stats and become targeting priority for every enemy
notes: kill-taboo: whoever lands the blow dies in forty days, no reload undoes it

name: the Anzu
terms: contracts with whoever can READ the register, not who owns it
defection_trigger: someone demonstrates literacy you lack; ties to the hidden-literacy thread
signature_mechanic: contact degrades enemy weapons; only bites what is already worn; broken means unarmed, not dead
notes: COST: weapons it unmakes cannot be captured, so riding it starves your only supply line

name: the Karkadann
terms: protects what it has decided to protect; nothing negotiates with it
defection_trigger: turns the moment you threaten the doves; state orders and its terms are simply incompatible
signature_mechanic: strong against mounted units; devastating charge that leaves it stuck one turn
notes: the plain one on purpose -- the roster needs one straightforwardly good option

name: the Shadhavar
terms: pacts through beauty; the lure is what it IS, not a trick it performs
signature_mechanic: every turn, pulls the nearest enemy one tile toward the rider; CANNOT be turned off
notes: liability on escort maps, asset on defend maps
